+@pytest.mark.sphinx('html', testroot='ext-autodoc')
+def test_automodule_inherited_members(app):
+    """Test that inherited-members option supports multiple classes."""
+    # Test with single class (backward compatibility)
+    options = {'members': None,
+               'inherited-members': 'Base1'}
+    actual = do_autodoc(app, 'class', 'target.multiinheritance.Derived', options)
+    # Should include base1_method (from Base1, which is filtered)
+    # Should include base2_method (from Base2, which is not filtered)
+    # Should include derived_method (from Derived)
+    assert '   .. py:method:: Derived.base1_method()' not in actual
+    assert '   .. py:method:: Derived.base2_method()' in actual
+    assert '   .. py:method:: Derived.derived_method()' in actual
+
+    # Test with multiple classes
+    options = {'members': None,
+               'inherited-members': 'Base1,Base2'}
+    actual = do_autodoc(app, 'class', 'target.multiinheritance.Derived', options)
+    # Should not include base1_method (from Base1, which is filtered)
+    # Should not include base2_method (from Base2, which is filtered)
+    # Should include derived_method (from Derived)
+    assert '   .. py:method:: Derived.base1_method()' not in actual
+    assert '   .. py:method:: Derived.base2_method()' not in actual
+    assert '   .. py:method:: Derived.derived_method()' in actual
